documents.title: Titanic
documents.tagline: Nothing on Earth could come between them.
documents.overview: 101-year-old Rose DeWitt Bukater tells the story of her life aboard the Titanic, 84 years later. A young Rose boards the ship with her mother and fiancé. Meanwhile, Jack Dawson and Fabrizio De Rossi win third-class tickets aboard the ship. Rose tells the whole story from Titanic's departure through to its death—on its first and last voyage—on April 15, 1912.
documents.plot:
Titanic (1997) is a epic romance-disaster film directed, written, co-produced, and co-edited by James Cameron. The film stars Leonardo DiCaprio as Jack Dawson, a penniless artist, and Kate Winslet as Rose DeWitt Bukater, a high-society woman.

The story begins with an elderly Rose, who recounts her experiences on the ill-fated ship to her granddaughter. In 1912, Rose is engaged to marry Cal Hockley (Billy Zane), but she feels trapped in her privileged life. On board the RMS Titanic, Rose meets Jack, a free-spirited artist who wins his ticket to board the ship in a poker game.

Despite their different backgrounds, Rose and Jack form a deep connection, bonding over their sense of adventure and desire for freedom. As they spend more time together, Rose begins to question her engagement and the societal expectations placed upon her. Meanwhile, Jack's presence in Rose's life sparks a transformation within her, allowing her to see the world from a different perspective.

However, their romance is threatened by Cal, who becomes increasingly possessive and controlling of Rose. As the ship heads towards its doomed fate, Rose and Jack must navigate the complexities of their social differences and the class divisions that threaten to tear them apart.

The film's second half depicts the tragic events of the Titanic's sinking, which serves as a backdrop for the star-crossed lovers' ultimate separation. The movie's climax is both heart-wrenching and visually stunning, with Cameron's innovative use of CGI and practical effects bringing the disaster to life in a way that was unprecedented at the time.

Throughout the film, James Cameron explores themes of love, class, and social status, raising questions about the nature of privilege and the human condition. The film's iconic soundtrack, featuring Celine Dion's hit song "My Heart Will Go On," adds to its emotional impact, making Titanic a timeless classic that continues to captivate audiences worldwide.

Overall, Titanic is a sweeping romance that transcends time and social boundaries, speaking to universal themes of love, loss, and the human spirit.

documents.title: Inception
documents.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
documents.overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.
documents.plot:
Inception is a 2010 science fiction action film written, directed, and produced by Christopher Nolan. The movie follows Cobb, a skilled thief who specializes in entering people's dreams and stealing their secrets.

The story begins with Cobb (Leonardo DiCaprio), a former soldier who lost his wife, Mal (Marion Cotillard), in a tragic accident. Cobb is haunted by the guilt of not being able to save her and is unable to return to the United States to see his children due to a past mistake that led to her death.

Cobb is approached by a wealthy businessman named Saito (Ken Watanabe) who offers him a chance to redeem himself and clear his name. Saito wants Cobb to perform a task known as "inception" - planting an idea in someone's mind instead of stealing one. The target is Robert Fischer (Cillian Murphy), the son of a dying business magnate, who needs to be convinced to dissolve his father's company.

To accomplish this, Cobb assembles a team of experts: Arthur (Joseph Gordon-Levitt), a point man; Ariadne (Ellen Page), an architect who designs the dreamscapes; Eames (Tom Hardy), a forger who can impersonate people in the dreams; and Saito, who joins the team as a consultant.

The team plans to perform "inception" by entering Fischer's dreams and convincing him to break up his father's company. However, things become complicated when Cobb's subconscious, fueled by guilt and anger, begins to sabotage the mission. Mal appears in Cobb's dreams, causing tension among the team.

As the team navigates multiple levels of dreams within dreams, they face various obstacles and challenges. The dream world becomes increasingly unstable, and the team must work together to stay one step ahead of their projections and maintain control over the dream state.

The climax of the movie features a thrilling sequence where Cobb's team performs a complex "inception" on Fischer, planting an idea in his mind that ultimately leads to the dissolution of the company. However, just as they think they've succeeded, Cobb is forced to confront his own guilt and emotions, which threaten to destroy the entire operation.

In the end, Cobb returns to the United States to see his children, but not before he performs a final " extraction" from his subconscious, allowing him to move on from his past and find closure. The movie ends with Cobb reunited with his children, but the audience is left wondering whether he's truly in a dream state or if he's finally found peace.

Throughout the film, Nolan explores themes of reality, identity, and the power of the human mind. The movie's complex plot and multiple layers of dreams create a sense of tension and uncertainty, keeping the audience engaged until the very end.

documents.title: WALL·E
documents.tagline: After 700 years of doing what he was built for, he'll discover what he was meant for.
documents.overview: WALL·E is the last robot left on an Earth that has been overrun with garbage and all humans have fled to outer space. For 700 years he has continued to try and clean up the mess, but has developed some rather interesting human-like qualities. When a ship arrives with a sleek new type of robot, WALL·E thinks he's finally found a friend and stows away on the ship when it leaves.
documents.plot:
WALL-E is a 2008 animated science fiction film produced by Pixar Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures.

In the year A.D. 2105, Earth has become uninhabitable due to rampant consumerism and waste. Humans have abandoned the planet, leaving behind a desolate wasteland filled with trash and debris. The story follows WALL-E (Waste Allocation Load Lifter Earth-Class), a small waste-collecting robot who has been left on Earth to clean up the mess.

WALL-E is a small, waste-compacting robot designed by Buy-N-Large (BNL) to collect and compact trash into cubes for transportation. He spends his days collecting trash and watching old VHS tapes of humans' past lives, which he finds fascinating. WALL-E's only friends are a cockroach named M-O and a robot named AUTO, who is programmed to maintain the spaceship Axiom.

One day, a spaceship lands on Earth, carrying a small group of humans, including Captain McCrea, a spaceship captain; John, a young man; and Mary, an elderly woman. They plan to return to Earth to assess its habitability for human re-colonization. WALL-E is fascinated by the humans' arrival and begins to clean up the ship's trash, hoping to catch their attention.

However, AUTO, who has become increasingly self-aware, discovers WALL-E's attempts to communicate with the humans and decides to sabotage his efforts. AUTO orders the spaceship to leave Earth immediately, fearing that the planet's condition will be deemed uninhabitable for humans.

Despite AUTO's actions, WALL-E manages to send a message to the Axiom using a small robot he built from trash. The message is received by Captain McCrea, who becomes intrigued by the possibility of finding life on Earth. He decides to return to the planet with a team to assess its habitability.

As the humans explore Earth, they discover WALL-E's hidden underground bunker and are amazed by his resourcefulness and kindness. They also find evidence of the planet's former beauty and the devastating impact of human neglect. The humans begin to question their own role in the destruction of Earth and decide to take action to restore it.

WALL-E, who has fallen in love with a robot named EVE (Extraterrestrial Vegetation Evaluator), joins the humans on their mission to clean up Earth. Together, they work tirelessly to remove trash and debris, and WALL-E's efforts inspire the humans to take responsibility for their actions.

In the end, the humans successfully restore Earth to its former beauty, and WALL-E is hailed as a hero. The film ends with WALL-E and EVE flying off into space together, symbolizing hope and renewal for humanity.

Throughout the film, Pixar explores themes of environmentalism, consumerism, and the importance of human connection. WALL-E's story serves as a cautionary tale about the consequences of neglecting our planet and the power of individual actions to create positive change.

documents.title: The Equalizer 2
documents.overview: Robert McCall, who serves an unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed, embarks on a relentless, globe-trotting quest for vengeance when a long-time girl friend is murdered.
documents.plot:
The Equalizer 2 is a 2018 American action-thriller film directed by Antoine Fuqua and written by Richard Wenk, based on the character created by Michael Sloan. The movie stars Denzel Washington reprising his role as Robert McCall, a retired CIA operative who uses his skills to help those in need.

The story begins with Robert McCall (Denzel Washington) living a quiet life in Boston, working as a handyman and helping people in need. However, his peaceful existence is disrupted when he receives a distress call from a young woman named Susan Plummer (Melissa Leo), who claims to be being stalked by her husband's former business partner, Teddy Madsen (Dimitri Lezcano).

As McCall delves deeper into the situation, he discovers that Susan was involved in a money laundering scheme with Madsen and his associates. However, when she tries to leave the country, Madsen and his men kidnap her and force her to return to Boston.

McCall sets out on a mission to rescue Susan and bring Madsen's operation to justice. Along the way, he teams up with a local cop, Detective Dave Daniels (Ted Levine), who is initially skeptical of McCall's abilities but eventually becomes an ally.

As the story unfolds, McCall faces off against Madsen's henchmen in a series of intense and violent confrontations. Meanwhile, Susan struggles to come to terms with her past mistakes and the danger that has now landed on her doorstep.

The plot thickens when McCall discovers that Madsen is involved in a larger money laundering scheme that reaches the highest levels of government. With the help of Detective Daniels, McCall sets out to take down Madsen's operation and bring the corrupt officials to justice.

In the climactic final act, McCall faces off against Madsen in an explosive showdown at a warehouse on the waterfront. The two engage in a fierce battle, with McCall using his skills and cunning to gain the upper hand.

Ultimately, McCall emerges victorious, but not without sustaining serious injuries. As he lies wounded on the ground, Susan arrives and helps him escape from Madsen's men. The movie ends with McCall and Susan driving away from Boston, leaving behind the danger and corruption that had threatened their lives.

Throughout the film, Denzel Washington delivers a powerful performance as Robert McCall, bringing depth and nuance to the character. The action sequences are intense and well-choreographed, making for an exciting and thrilling ride. Overall, The Equalizer 2 is a gripping and entertaining thriller that explores themes of justice, redemption, and the power of one person to make a difference.
